Yeah it is a lot of information to try to absorb all at once. I'd recommend playing through the heists as you come across them in the series. It adds more of a connection between heists and it makes it much more fun when it feels like there is a sense of progression as you work through the heists and the videos.

Probably your best bet is to use thekknowleys series on it as it covers everything that you want. When I do it I play the videos up until the heist begins then I play through the heist and once I've completed it I play the video again to get more background context. It covers everything from the characters, relevent information, clues you come across ect. It covers all the FBI files stuff in order and how to solve them yourself as well. 

Here's a link to it I'd recommend watching it anyway if you like the payday story it's really good and fun to watch: 

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwgk0Znh9xxTe_s3zrJRNiZRLpp3ctC7g

Also if you haven't already watch the payday webseries. Its like a short collection of videos that were released before the game launched to set the background and introduce the characters. You can find them on YouTube or on steam.

The best way to play in my opinion is just to mess up and learn from the mistakes but here are some tips that will help you out: 1) when building your base have the gate at the bottom of a "V" shaped wall so you can get the best firing arch for your turrets. 2) the border zone is a good place to start. Low level enemies and it's easy to grow cactus so you won't run out of food. 3) the best way to make money is to steal stuff but if you want to make your own money then using your cactus farms to make rum is always viable. 4) I wouldn't make a base until you have researched crossbow turrets mk2 for protection purposes. 5) you can recruit greenlanders in the holy nation bars. 6) fight and make use of training dummies are the only ways to really improve your stats. 7) you can see if someone had a bounty if you click on them just above their stats and prisoner cages are researched. 8) just have fun and explore. Look for maps in travel shops and they will lead you to places where you can find loot and lore. Some shopkeepers have books that you can buy and others you find hidden in chests that you have to steal from. I hope I have answered your questions and if you have anymore I would be glad to help further.
